scope: Connected Supabase security advisor and read-only catalog review; no schema/grant/Auth changes

lints.name: rls_enabled_no_policy
lints.title: RLS Enabled No Policy
lints.description: Detects cases where row level security (RLS) has been enabled on a table but no RLS policies have been created.

findings.detail: Table \`public.beta_access\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist
Table \`public.beta_registration_attempts\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist
Table \`public.beta_waitlist\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist

lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.rls_auto_enable()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/rls_auto_enable`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

lints.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.accept_project_invite(invite_hash text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/accept_project_invite`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.create_project(project_title text, project_mode text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/create_project`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.current_project_role(target_project_id uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/current_project_role`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.is_project_member(target_project_id uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/is_project_member`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.rls_auto_enable()` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/rls_auto_enable`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

lints.name: auth_leaked_password_protection
lints.title: Leaked Password Protection Disabled
lints.description: Leaked password protection is currently disabled.

findings.detail: Supabase Auth prevents the use of compromised passwords by checking against HaveIBeenPwned.org. Enable this feature to enhance security.

interpretation.privateTables: RLS enabled without client policies is intentional; anon/authenticated table grants were previously verified absent
interpretation.projectRpcFunctions: Authenticated definer functions are intentional, bound to current Auth UID, fresh beta approval and project authority; retain existing create/accept/role contracts
interpretation.autoRlsEventTrigger: returns event_trigger, attached to ensure_rls, fixed pg_catalog search path, follows documented auto-RLS pattern; anonymous RPC probe returns 400/0A000 and performs no DDL; grants remain unchanged
interpretation.leakedPasswordProtection: Reported disabled by the advisor; no Auth setting change or paid plan upgrade performed

limits: Not independent signed-in sessions or intended Linux runtime acceptance
Auth URL configuration is not exposed by the connected tools
